📋 ACTIVATION TASKS (User Action Required)

[ ] TASK 1: Deploy Sentry (15 minutes)
    ├─ Go to: https://sentry.io → Sign up (free)
    ├─ Create project: Node.js
    ├─ Copy SENTRY_DSN
    ├─ In Railway: Settings → Variables → add SENTRY_DSN
    ├─ Redeploy
    ├─ Verify logs: "Monitoring: Sentry initialized."
    └─ File: .github/SENTRY_SETUP.md

[ ] TASK 2: Deploy Uptime Monitoring (10 minutes)
    ├─ Option A (Recommended): Better Stack (https://betterstack.com/uptime)
    │  ├─ Sign up (free)
    │  ├─ New Monitor → HTTPS
    │  ├─ URL: https://goreturn.pro/api/health
    │  ├─ Frequency: 30 seconds
    │  ├─ Alert: Email to owner
    │  └─ Save
    │
    ├─ Option B: UptimeRobot (https://uptimerobot.com)
    │  ├─ Sign up (free)
    │  ├─ Add Monitor → HTTP(s)
    │  ├─ URL: https://goreturn.pro/api/health
    │  ├─ Interval: 5 minutes
    │  ├─ Alert: Email to owner
    │  └─ Save
    │
    └─ File: .github/UPTIME_MONITORING.md

[ ] TASK 3: Configure Alert Routing (5 minutes)
    ├─ Sentry: Add email alert contact + enable
    ├─ Better Stack: Configure email alerts
    ├─ (Optional) Slack integration for team visibility
    ├─ (Optional) SMS escalation for critical incidents
    └─ File: .github/MONITORING_QUICK_START.md

[ ] TASK 4: Create On-Call Runbook (5 minutes)
    ├─ Document alert response procedures
    ├─ List common issues + fixes
    ├─ Define escalation chain
    ├─ Add owner/team contact info
    └─ File: .github/ONCALL_RUNBOOK.md (create yourself)

🎯 EXPECTED ALERT COVERAGE (Post-Activation)

Detection Time    │ Issue Type             │ Alert Method
──────────────────┼────────────────────────┼─────────────────────
<30 seconds       │ App crash              │ Sentry email
<30 seconds       │ Uncaught exception     │ Sentry email
<30 seconds       │ Database error         │ Sentry email
<30 seconds       │ Webhook failure (500)  │ Sentry email
30-60 seconds     │ App/DB down            │ Better Stack email
<5 minutes        │ Error rate spike       │ Built-in email
Daily             │ Backup failure         │ Built-in email
Real-time         │ Auth failure           │ Activity log

💰 COST ANALYSIS

Service           │ Free Tier      │ Price/Month │ Recommendation
──────────────────┼────────────────┼─────────────┼──────────────
Sentry            │ 5K events/mo   │ $29 for 50K │ Free tier sufficient
Better Stack      │ Unlimited      │ $9 + SMS    │ Start free tier
UptimeRobot       │ Unlimited      │ Free+       │ Alternative free option
──────────────────┴────────────────┴─────────────┴──────────────
Total Monthly     │ FREE           │ $0-20       │ Easily fits budget

Expected usage: 30-150 events/month = well within free tier

🔒 SECURITY VERIFICATION (Sentry Data Handling)

Redacted Data (NOT sent to Sentry):
✅ Access tokens       → [redacted]
✅ Refresh tokens      → [redacted]
✅ Session tokens      → [redacted]
✅ Passwords           → [redacted]
✅ OTPs                → [redacted]
✅ API keys            → [redacted]
✅ Customer email      → [redacted-pii]
✅ Customer phone      → [redacted-pii]
✅ Customer name       → [redacted-pii]

Safe Data (Sent to Sentry):
✅ shop_domain         → test-store.myshopify.com (merchant ID)
✅ route               → /api/webhooks/refunds-create
✅ error_type          → webhook_failure
✅ method              → POST
✅ Stack trace         → Code locations
✅ Timestamp           → Error time
